description: Usage — How resource was actually used by the AI system.

attribution.description: Structured attribution details for each citation provided.

citation_included.description: Whether citation was included as required by the offer terms.

consumed_quantity.description:
For a metered (PER_UNIT) transaction this is C in the settlement rule on
 Pricing: it is charged at the offer's rate up to the ceiling the offer's
 estimated_quantity and estimate_tolerance_bps fix, and the quantity above
 that ceiling is held for dispute. The agent reports what it consumed, not
 what it estimated: an Exchange MUST NOT refuse a report because this
 differs from the estimate, in either direction, and MUST NOT charge a
 quantity above the ceiling without a dispute resolving it.
consumed_quantity.title:
REQUIRED. Actual quantity consumed, in the metering unit from the Offer's Pricing.
 For text: tokens consumed. For video: seconds watched. For data: records accessed.

consumed_unit.description:
Metering unit for consumed_quantity. Must match the Offer's Pricing.unit.
 If omitted, defaults to "tokens". Same token format as Pricing.unit:
 a bare registered token or a vendor:namespaced token.

displayed_to_user.description: Whether resource/output was displayed to a human.

function.description:
How the resource was used. Standard values: "ai-train", "ai-input",
 "ai-index", "search", "display". Multiple allowed.
 CoMP-specific values available via fora-comp-v1 extension profile.
